insurer_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Covered up to Sum Insured; no room rent capping

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day care procedures + Modern Treatments (Deep Brain Stimulation, robotic surgery, stem cell etc.) covered up to SI

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Home Care / Domiciliary covered up to Sum Insured

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Covered up to Sum Insured (minimum 24 hr hospitalisation)

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance up to Rs 2,000 per hospitalisation; Air ambulance up to Rs 2,50,000 per hospitalisation

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Refill Benefit — one-time reinstatement equal to Base Sum Insured, now applies even for same illness, triggers after 1st paid claim

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Annual from day 1; Rs 500 per Rs 1L base SI (max Rs 5,000 individual / Rs 10,000 family) on defined test list

notable_exclusions_summary: Comprehensive indemnity. No room rent cap. Pre/post 60/180 days. Refill applies even to same illness. Hospital cash, Safeguard / Safeguard+ optional. Air ambulance Rs 2.5L.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via 10,000+ network hospitals (30-minute processing target). Pre-auth via hospital. Reimbursement via Niva Bupa app or website; intimation within 48 hrs of admission to non-network hospital. Insta reimbursement available via app.
